parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pot, made of ceramic, with a rounded shape and smooth surface. It serves as the primary storage area for contents.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids and provides the main volume of the pot. It connects to the lid and bottom to form a sealed container.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move relative to other parts during normal use.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the pot, made of ceramic, circular in shape, and designed to fit snugly on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the container to prevent spillage, retain heat, and protect the contents from contamination.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated to open or close the pot.

parts.name: Bottom
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom base of the pot, made of ceramic, flat and circular to provide stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the pot and ensures it stands upright on flat surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal use.
